title: Kasai training example
description: One instruction-tuning example for the Kasai Nigerian tax-law SLM. Every example must trace back to a provision in the preprocessed corpus (provenance.chunk_id) and carry an explicit legal status so current and repealed law are never mixed silently. Records enter with review.status='pending' and only 'approved' records may reach train/validation/test splits.

id.description: Stable unique id: uppercase domain/topic prefix + serial, e.g. VAT_001, NRSEA_014.

instruction.description: The question or task, as the end user would ask it.

context.description: The legal provision text the answer is grounded in (verbatim from the corpus chunk, trimmed to what is relevant).

response.description: The grounded answer. Must be derivable from context and cite its basis; must distinguish current from repealed law where relevant.

source.description: Human-readable source title, e.g. 'Nigeria Revenue Service (Establishment) Act, 2025'.

law.description: Short law/document identifier: NRSEA, JRBA, NTA, NTAA, CITA, PITA, VATA, WHT_REGS, NRS_CIRCULAR_2026_01, NRS_FAQ, ...

section.description: Section number or unit within the law ('12', '4(2)', a circular heading number like '6.1', or an FAQ topic). Empty string only when the source has no sectioning.

tax_domain.description: Provisional domain list; Cecilia's taxonomy.json is the authority and this enum will be regenerated from it.

topic.description: Topic within the domain, e.g. 'Registration', 'Tax Rate'. Values from Cecilia's taxonomy once published.

legal_status.description: Status of the underlying provision. 'repealed'/'superseded' examples belong to the negative benchmark, never to ordinary training data.

effective_date.description: ISO date the provision took effect; empty string if unknown.

replacement_legislation.description: For repealed/superseded provisions: what replaced them. Empty otherwise.

chunk_id.description: chunk_id in data/processed/**/*.jsonl this example is grounded in.

status.description: Set by legal reviewers (KeshTech/Cecilia) only. Everything starts 'pending'.
